prompts.steam:
Use case: stylized-concept. A DISASSEMBLED PAPER THEATRE KIT for an Emerald fire-gym bathhouse, transparent 1536x1024 atlas. Six SEPARATE pieces in 3 columns x 2 rows with at least 35px transparent gutters. No complete finished building anywhere. Completely flat cut-paper silhouettes, matte fibers, thin cream cut edges, subtle contact shadows. Terracotta, red cedar, ochre, turquoise. No text, characters, floor or shell.
TOP LEFT: plain tall warm tan arched backing panel, lightly mottled fibrous paper, ONLY sparse darker paper seam lines, no architecture, emblems, banners or objects printed on it.
TOP MIDDLE: open HOLLOW redwood arch of rafters and short tiled-roof strips, layered curved beams with transparent openings and no wall behind. Full arch visible.
TOP RIGHT: hanging garland: thin copper pipe with 3 attached warm paper lanterns and 2 curling cream steam-cloud cutouts, no wall behind.
BOTTOM LEFT: one group of three stepped dark red timber posts with horizontal cross-brackets, tall and narrow, completely isolated.
BOTTOM MIDDLE: ONE isolated flame medallion, round ochre/tan paper disk with layered red flame cutout.
BOTTOM RIGHT: low wide bathhouse front strip with 3 circular stone-paper water outlets and turquoise spillways flowing into a narrow terracotta trough, NO wall or roof above the outlets.
All pieces physically disconnected, full silhouettes with padding, actual transparency around them, rich sophisticated flat paper craft, not a 3D model or voxel. Each must be usable on its own layer in a folding book.
